propositions: The current per-criterion fan-out completion recovery explodes token cost (440 requests worst case) and wall-clock cost; verified work from the primary run is discarded on failure; recovery itself can die verdict-less with no progress.

Replace per-criterion fan-out with banked incremental criterion verdicts recorded at CompletionAgentStep by a new record_criterion_verdict tool; successor runs are batched by unverified remainder criteria under a request budget pool, never per-criterion.

Deterministic criterion ID (`c<index>-<sha256[:8]>`) enables remainder scoping, ID-based coverage validation (order-insensitive), and bank lookups; bank entries carry ticket/material-fingerprint/tree-sha stamps with successor preflight validation.

On typed primary failure (LLMBudgetExhausted, RunawayToolLoop), launch batched successors with <=8 criteria per batch (standard model class), budget pool = 1.5x N where N = ceil(verify_step_floor(c)/2); per-run allocation floor(remaining_pool/remaining_runs); zero-progress stops recovery.

If any verdicts are banked, finalizer ALWAYS emits full-coverage verdict: verified criteria from banked evidence, unverified as met=false placeholders; on finalizer failure, deterministic no-LLM fallback (certifiable=false) ensures no verdict-less outcome with progress.

Criteria-scaled primary step floor verify_step_floor(c) = clamp(8c, 48, 480) and path-normalized read_file memo caching (whole-file once, slice all ranges from cache) together reduce runaway exhaustion frequency and token waste in verification runs.
